vibe-game.quote: generates dungeons, mazes, architecture, puzzles, and simulations on 2D/3D grids
vibe-game.reason: A ready-made procedural generation engine for building game levels in 3D, with .vox output.

organize.quote: fills the YouTube-to-markdown gap for learning-vault capture
organize.reason: Turns saved videos into markdown notes, which is the capture step of the user's note system.

agent-viz.quote: A browser-accessible URL shows the mission board with task tree, status, and handoffs.
agent-viz.reason: A live web view of coordinated agents and their status, close to the view the user wants.

hybrid-memory.quote: SQLite-backed knowledge graph, a CLI, and 26 MCP tools
hybrid-memory.reason: A comparable local coding-agent memory with a deterministic graph, recall search and optional fastembed embeddings.

hybrid-memory.quote: 98.4% with hybrid heuristics (keyword boosting, temporal proximity, preference patterns)
hybrid-memory.reason: Local agent memory that pairs semantic search with keyword boosting, so the hybrid approaches can be compared directly.

wiki-scale.quote: All benchmarks reproducible from the repository.
wiki-scale.reason: Its reproducible R@5 retrieval benchmarking shows a way to check that search still finds the right records.

ocr-bench.quote: Docling (8 load-balanced instances) for PDF layout detection, Qwen3-VL via vLLM for table/figure/formula reading
ocr-bench.reason: A PDF pipeline that combines a CPU parser with a VLM for tables and figures, and reports its throughput honestly.

hybrid-memory.quote: Structured markdown scaffold + 11-checker drift-detection CLI for persistent AI agent memory
hybrid-memory.reason: Another markdown-based agent memory design to compare against.

wiki-scale.quote: runs 11 zero-token checkers against the real codebase to detect drift
wiki-scale.reason: A lint and health-check approach for markdown memory whose cost could be benchmarked as the record count grows.

hybrid-memory.quote: Dense vectors + sparse vectors (SPLADE, BGE-M3) + native BM25 full-text search, fused via configurable reranking
hybrid-memory.reason: A reference implementation of lexical plus semantic hybrid search; Milvus Lite can be embedded.

ocr-bench.quote: converts PDFs, images, Office docs (Word/PPT/Excel), EPUB, OFD, HTML/MHTML, CSV into LLM-ready Markdown/JSON with four quality tiers
ocr-bench.reason: A PDF-to-markdown candidate with a CPU path and a GPU VLM path (needs 8+ GB VRAM) to add to the benchmark.

hybrid-memory.quote: Agent tasks: tool retrieval, GUI control, agent memory retrieval
hybrid-memory.reason: Includes agent-memory retrieval tasks, which can help pick the embedding model for the semantic layer.

agent-viz.quote: Herdr / Orca:** Most frequently recommended — orchestrator features, multi-pane views
agent-viz.reason: Practitioners keeping track of several concurrent agents, with terminal tools and statusline approaches.

agent-viz.quote: agent network with persistent identity across sessions/machines, multi-step plans with dependency ordering and auto-assignment to idle agents
agent-viz.reason: A coordination server that tracks agent identity and work state, which a live agent view could be built on.
